column3: “the manslayer” renders “the killer (rotseah)” (also in verses 11–12 and 25–28).
“the larger” and “the smaller” render “the many” and “the few,” and “in proportion to” renders “according to the mouth of.”
“select” renders “make happen (appoint),” “any person” renders “a soul (nefesh),” and “unintentionally” renders “by inadvertence (shegagah)” (also in verse 15).
“a murderer” renders the same word, “a killer (rotseah),” used for the manslayer (also in verses 17–21 and 30–31); “shall surely be put to death” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
“a stone in the hand” renders “a stone of hand,” and NASB supplies “as a result” (also in verses 18 and 20–21).
“The blood avenger” renders “the redeemer (go’el) of blood” (also in verses 21 and 24–27).
“shall surely be put to death” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
“suddenly” renders “in an instant,” and “something” renders “any weapon (keli).”
“any deadly object of stone” renders “any stone by which one may die.”
“the high priest” renders “the great priest” (also in verse 28), and “the holy oil” renders “the oil of holiness.”
“at any time” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
“he shall not be guilty of blood” renders “there is no blood for him.”
“a statutory ordinance” renders “a statute of judgment.”
“at the evidence of” renders “at the mouth of.”
